_comment: chirp ground (NFM) daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. Separate UDP port + state path + hit log + icecast fallback from airband so the two daemons can coexist. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for ground. Production cutover (Phase 4d) targets the analog RSPduo serial 1809063632 with mode=SL tuner=2 to coexist with rtl-airband-airband's MA-master on the same physical RSPduo. center_freq_hz set to 138.05 MHz (177th Fighter Wing — the busiest ground channel by far in rtl-airband's stats).
